event: The party enters a Floor 7 chamber; Solenne finds the nest count is wrong.
Arcane Analysis shows four nests, not one: thirty-one Stoneback Crawlers.
The nearest crawlers advance across the floor toward the party's entry point.
Solenne starts reciting the full analysis too fast.
Dayo cuts in with 'Sol' and asks how many are on the left.
Solenne answers: eight on the left, coming through the lower root system.
Dayo calls the plan: she takes the left cluster; regen, armor, six seconds.
Dayo goes before Solenne finishes her plan; for eight seconds plan and fight diverge.
The party finds its rhythm and the gap closes.
Dayo hits the left cluster with Shield Rush, scattering three crawlers.
Dayo plants with Iron Stance as the cluster's fixed point.
Dayo catches a flanking crawler on her buckler and redirects it into the wall.
Miriam's Nature's Veil regen settles on Dayo; Miriam watches the fight from 12 m back.
Tomás fires from the west overhang, crippling a crawler; Dayo finishes it.
Tomás drops a second crawler with another joint shot.
Nadia's Chaos Grenade lands at the colony center and rolls Sleep on four of six.
Four crawlers fall asleep, opening six seconds in the swarm's coordination.
Nadia celebrates the Sleep four-of-six from the east wall, reaching for a knife.
Solenne, steadier, feeds targeting data to the party through Harmony Conductor.
Solenne calls for Vesper.
Vesper Quick Crafts a Paralysis Touch gel strip in two and a half seconds.
Vesper crosses to Dayo and slaps the strip onto Dayo's right gauntlet mid-swing.
Dayo strikes the largest crawler with the paralysis gauntlet; it locks up and falls.
Dayo calls 'Two' and finishes the last two awake crawlers on her side.
Nadia crosses the chamber and knifes a crawler flanking toward Miriam.
The sleepers wake and a messier second half follows, never in doubt.
The fight ends; thirty-one crawlers lie dead in the chamber.
Solenne leans on her staff; her morning chalk formula is smeared by her grip.
The System reports Chamber 14 cleared and Floor 7 kill progress 94/96.
Solenne notes they are two kills short of the Skill Book bonus.
Dayo tests her hit left shoulder; her HP sits at sixty-three percent.
Miriam heals Dayo's shoulder with Mending Touch without asking.
Vesper crouches by the colony queen's remains, examining its dropped Core.
Tomás climbs down, checks his quiver, and gathers his fired arrows.
Nadia picks up the queen's Core and names the queen Gertrude.
Dayo laughs loudly at Nadia's bit.
Vesper asks Nadia not to name the Core; Nadia insists on Gertrude.
Miriam's mouth twitches as she keeps healing Dayo.
Solenne weighs the party's condition against hunting two more crawlers.
Solenne calls for the rest node and puts off the corridor sweep to tomorrow.
Nobody argues; the party falls into its usual marching formation.
Solenne notes that choosing their wellbeing came easier than it used to.
Dayo scratches a tally mark inside her left bracer for Chamber 14.
Nadia sees Dayo make the mark and says nothing.
The party walks the warm root tunnel toward the rest node.
Tomás scouts ahead in silence.
Solenne muses that she has no word yet for what the six of them are.
As Tomás passes the north wall, Solenne's Resonance Map senses dissonance.
Solenne senses a Mana-responsive, door-shaped space in the north wall.
Tomás angles away from the wall, showing Solenne he sensed it too.
Tomás does not report the anomaly, unlike everything else he reports.
Solenne makes a mental note of the door and tells no one.
The party reaches the amber-lit rest node entrance.
Tomás checks the interior and nods clear; the party files in.
Dayo steps through and her shoulders drop as Iron Stance tension leaves.
Nadia says something to Vesper, who almost laughs.
Miriam touches Solenne's wrist as she passes in, last before her.
Solenne steps through and the rest node seals behind her.
Solenne thinks of tomorrow's sweep and wonders if the door can wait.
